stem: I _____ three different countries since I started the Erasmus programme.
explanation_tr: 'Since I started' ifadesi gecmiste baslayip hala devam eden bir durumu gosterir. Bu yuzden Present Perfect (have visited) kullanilir. Past Simple olsaydi 'since' degil 'last year' gibi bitmis bir zaman zarfi olurdu.
rule_tr: since/for + Present Perfect (have/has + V3) — gecmisten simdi'ye uzanan eylemler
tip_tr: 'Since' gordugunde Present Perfect kullan. 'Since' = o zamandan beri (hala devam ediyor).
extra_example: She has lived in Aydin since September. (Eylul'den beri Aydin'da yasiyor.)

stem: By the time the ambulance arrived, the paramedics _____ first aid to the patient.
explanation_tr: 'By the time + Past Simple' yapisi, o andan once tamamlanmis bir eylemi gosterir. 'Ambulans geldiginde, ilk yardim zaten verilmisti.' — gecmisin gecmisi = Past Perfect.
rule_tr: By the time + Past Simple, ... had + V3 (Past Perfect) — gecmisin gecmisi
tip_tr: 'By the time' = ...zamana kadar. Iki gecmis eylemden ONCE olan = had + V3.
extra_example: By the time I got home, my family had already eaten dinner. (Eve vardigimda ailem yemegi coktan yemisti.)

stem: By next June, she _____ her medical degree and will start her residency.
explanation_tr: 'By next June' gelecekte belirli bir zaman noktasina kadar tamamlanmis olacak bir eylemi gosterir. Future Perfect (will have + V3) kullanilir.
rule_tr: By + gelecek zaman ifadesi + will have + V3 (Future Perfect)
tip_tr: 'By next...' veya 'By the end of...' gordugunde Future Perfect dusun.
extra_example: By 2027, I will have graduated from university. (2027'ye kadar universiteden mezun olmus olacagim.)

stem: If I _____ more time, I would learn a third foreign language.
explanation_tr: Ana cumle 'would learn' icerdiginden bu 2. kosul cumlesidir (Second Conditional). Gercekte yeterli zamanin yok ama hayal ediyorsun. If + Past Simple, would + V1.
rule_tr: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple, ... would + V1 (simdi/gelecek icin gercek disi hayal)
tip_tr: Would gorursen 'if' cumleciginde Past Simple ara. Have -> had olur.
extra_example: If I were you, I would apply for the scholarship. (Senin yerinde olsam bursa basvururdum.)

stem: If she had studied harder, she _____ the Erasmus language exam.
explanation_tr: 'If she had studied' = Past Perfect, bu 3. kosul cumlesidir (Third Conditional). Gecmiste gerceklesmeyen bir durumun sonucunu ifade eder. Ana cumle: would have + V3.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect (had + V3), ... would have + V3 (gecmiste gerceklesmemis hayal)
tip_tr: If cumleciginde 'had + V3' varsa, ana cumlede 'would have + V3' olmali.
extra_example: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended. (Toplantidan haberim olsaydi, katilirdim.)

stem: If he _____ afraid of flying, he would have joined the Erasmus programme in Spain.
explanation_tr: Bu mixed conditional'dir. 'Would have joined' gecmise ait bir sonuc, ama ucmaktan korkma genel/kalici bir durumdur (simdiki). If + Past Simple (weren't), would have + V3.
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional: If + Past Simple (genel durum), would have + V3 (gecmis sonuc)
tip_tr: Genel bir ozellik (korkak olmak) gecmisteki bir sonucu etkiliyorsa mixed conditional kullan.
extra_example: If she spoke French, she would have got the job. (Fransizca bilseydi, isi alirdi.)

stem: The _____ of the new research centre will create many job opportunities for scientists.
explanation_tr: 'The _____ of' yapisi bir isim (noun) gerektirir. 'Establish' fiilinin isim hali 'establishment'tir (kuruluş). The + ___ + of = isim olmali.
rule_tr: The + NOUN + of ... yapisi icin fiilden isim turet: establish -> establishment, develop -> development
tip_tr: 'The ___ of' gordugunde bosluga isim (noun) gelecegini bil. -ment, -tion, -ness, -ity gibi ekler isim yapar.
extra_example: The development of new vaccines is crucial. (Yeni asilarin gelistirilmesi cok onemli.)

stem: The professor's lecture was very _____ and all the students learned a lot.
explanation_tr: 'Was very _____' yapisi bir sifat (adjective) gerektirir. 'Very' zarfindan sonra sifat gelir. 'Information' isminden 'informative' sifati turetilir.
rule_tr: very + ADJECTIVE: information -> informative, create -> creative, imagine -> imaginative
tip_tr: 'Very' kelimesinden sonra her zaman sifat gelir. -ive, -ful, -ous, -able gibi ekler sifat yapar.
extra_example: The documentary was very informative. (Belgesel cok bilgilendiriciydi.)

stem: It would be _____ to skip the safety training before entering the laboratory.
explanation_tr: Guvenlik egitimini atlamak sorumsuzluk olur. 'Responsible' kelimesinin olumsuz hali 'irresponsible'dir. Her kelimenin kendi olumsuz eki vardir.
rule_tr: Olumsuz onekler: ir- (responsible -> irresponsible), un- (happy -> unhappy), dis- (agree -> disagree), im- (possible -> impossible)
tip_tr: 'r' ile baslayan sifatlarda genellikle 'ir-' oneki kullanilir: irregular, irrelevant, irresponsible.
extra_example: It is irregular to submit assignments after the deadline. (Son tarihten sonra odev teslim etmek kuraldisi.)

stem: I need to have my laptop _____ before the semester starts.
explanation_tr: 'Have something done' yapisi baskasina bir is yaptirmak demektir. have + nesne + V3 (past participle). Laptopumu tamir ettirmem gerekiyor.
rule_tr: Causative: have/get + nesne + V3 (past participle) = baskasina yaptirmak
tip_tr: Sen yapmiyorsun, baskasina yaptiriyorsun = have + nesne + V3. Repair -> repaired.
extra_example: She had her hair cut yesterday. (Dun saclarini kestirdi — baskasi kesti.)

stem: The doctor made the patient _____ in bed for a week after the operation.
explanation_tr: 'Make + kisi + V1 (yalin fiil)' yapisi birisini bir sey yapmaya zorlamak/mecbur birakma anlamindadir. 'To' eklenmez!
rule_tr: make + kisi + V1 (yalin fiil, to yok!) = zorlamak | let + kisi + V1 = izin vermek
tip_tr: Make ve let'ten sonra ASLA 'to' gelmez. Direkt yalin fiil (bare infinitive) kullan.
extra_example: The teacher let the students leave early. (Ogretmen ogrencilerin erken gitmesine izin verdi.)

stem: You haven't submitted your assignment yet, _____?
explanation_tr: Ana cumle olumsuz (haven't submitted), bu yuzden soru kuyrugu olumlu olmali: have you? Olumsuz cumle + olumlu tag / Olumlu cumle + olumsuz tag.
rule_tr: Question Tags: Olumlu cumle -> olumsuz tag | Olumsuz cumle -> olumlu tag
tip_tr: Ana cumlede 'haven't' (olumsuz) var, tag 'have you' (olumlu) olmali. Yardimci fiili eslestirir.
extra_example: She is a doctor, isn't she? (O bir doktor, degil mi?)

stem: Nobody came to the lecture yesterday, _____?
explanation_tr: 'Nobody' zaten olumsuz anlam tasir, bu yuzden tag olumlu olmali: did they? 'Nobody/nothing/never' gibi kelimeler cumleyi olumsuz yapar.
rule_tr: nobody/nothing/never/hardly = olumsuz anlam -> olumlu tag | Zamiri 'they' olur (nobody icin)
tip_tr: Nobody, nothing, no one cumlelerde olumsuz anlam tasir ama yapisal olarak olumlu gorunur. Tag'i olumlu yap.
extra_example: Nothing happened, did it? (Hicbir sey olmadi, degil mi?)

stem: The _____ you study, the _____ your exam results will be.
explanation_tr: 'The + karsilastirma, the + karsilastirma' yapisi iki seyin birbirine paralel degisimini gosterir. 'Ne kadar cok calisirsan, sonuclarin o kadar iyi olur.'
rule_tr: The + comparative, the + comparative = ne kadar ... o kadar ...
tip_tr: The more... the better/easier/harder gibi kaliplari ezberle.
extra_example: The earlier you wake up, the more productive you will be. (Ne kadar erken kalkarsan o kadar verimli olursun.)

stem: There is _____ time left before the exam, so we should start studying immediately.
explanation_tr: 'Time' sayilamayan bir isimdir, bu yuzden 'few' degil 'little' kullanilir. 'We should start studying immediately' (hemen calismaliyiz) ifadesi zamanin yetersiz oldugunu gosterir. 'Little' = az (olumsuz anlam), 'a little' = biraz (olumlu anlam).
rule_tr: little (olumsuz: neredeyse hic) / a little (olumlu: biraz) = sayilamayan isimler | few / a few = sayilabilen isimler
tip_tr: Cumlenin geri kalani olumsuz bir anlam tasiyorsa 'little/few' (a'siz), olumlu ise 'a little/a few' kullan.
extra_example: There is little hope of recovery. (Iyilasme umudu neredeyse yok.)

passage: Antibiotic resistance has become one of the most serious threats to global public health. When bacteria are repeatedly exposed to antibiotics, they can develop mutations that make them resistant to treatment. This means that common infections could become untreatable, leading to longer hospital stays, higher medical costs, and increased mortality. The World Health Organisation has warned that without urgent action, the world is heading towards a 'post-antibiotic era' in which minor injuries and common diseases could once again become fatal. Reducing unnecessary prescriptions and completing the full course of antibiotics are among the key strategies to combat this growing problem.
stem: What is the main argument of this passage?

options.text: Bacteria are becoming resistant to antibiotics, which is a major health threat.
Hospitals should stop using antibiotics for minor infections.
The WHO has solved the antibiotic resistance problem.
New antibiotics are being developed faster than ever.

explanation_tr: Paragrafin ana argumani bakterilerin antibiyotiklere direnc gelistirmesinin ciddi bir saglik tehdidi oldugudur. Tum paragraf bu sorunu ve sonuclarini anlatıyor.
rule_tr: Ana arguman sorusunda tum paragrafi kapsayan, ne eksik ne fazla olan secenegi bul.
tip_tr: Ilk cumle genelde ana fikri verir: 'Antibiotic resistance... most serious threats'.

passage: Cultural shock is a common experience among international students. It typically occurs in four stages: the honeymoon phase, where everything feels exciting and new; the frustration phase, where differences in language, food, and customs become overwhelming; the adjustment phase, where students gradually adapt to the new culture; and the acceptance phase, where they feel comfortable in their new environment. Understanding these stages can help students prepare mentally for the challenges of studying abroad and reassure them that their feelings of confusion or frustration are perfectly normal.
stem: According to the passage, during which phase do students start to feel comfortable?
explanation_tr: Paragrafta 'acceptance phase, where they feel comfortable in their new environment' (kabul asamasi, yeni ortamlarinda rahat hissettikleri asama) deniyor.
rule_tr: 'Feel comfortable' ifadesini metinde bul ve hangi asama ile eslestigini belirle.
tip_tr: Her asama 'where' kelimesiyle aciklaniyor. 'Feel comfortable' = acceptance phase.

tip_tr: Son cumle genelde 'neden bu bilgi onemli?' sorusunun cevabini verir.

passage: Microplastics — tiny plastic particles smaller than 5 millimetres — have been found in every corner of the planet, from the deepest ocean trenches to the highest mountain peaks. These particles enter the environment through the breakdown of larger plastic items, synthetic clothing fibres released during washing, and industrial waste. Marine animals often mistake microplastics for food, which can lead to starvation and death. Recent studies have also detected microplastics in human blood and lungs, raising serious concerns about potential health effects including inflammation and cellular damage. Scientists urge governments to implement stricter regulations on plastic production and waste management.
stem: What can be inferred about the scope of microplastic pollution?

options.text: It is limited to ocean environments.
It is a widespread problem found everywhere on Earth.
It has been completely solved by scientists.
It only comes from industrial waste.

explanation_tr: Paragrafta mikroplastiklerin 'every corner of the planet, from the deepest ocean trenches to the highest mountain peaks' (gezegenin her kosesinde, en derin okyanus cukurlarindan en yuksek dag zirvelerine kadar) bulundugu belirtiliyor.
rule_tr: Cikarim sorusunda metindeki kanıtlara dayanarak sonuc cikar, asiri yorumlama.
tip_tr: 'Every corner of the planet' = her yerde = widespread (yaygin).

tip_tr: 'Mistake for food' = yiyecek sanmak. Bu ifadeyi metinde bul.

stem: The word 'urge' in the last sentence is closest in meaning to _____.
explanation_tr: 'Urge' fiili 'siddetle tesvik etmek / ısrarla talep etmek' anlamindadir. Bilim insanlari hukumetleri 'strongly encourage' (guclu bir sekilde tesvik etmek) ediyor.
rule_tr: Kelime anlami sorusunda kelimenin gecen cumlesini oku ve baglam icerisinde anlamini cikar.
tip_tr: Urge = siddette istemek, zorlamak degil ama guclu bir tesvik. 'Strongly encourage' en yakin anlam.

stem:
Student: I'm thinking of dropping organic chemistry. It's too difficult for me.
Advisor: _____
Student: You're right. I'll try the tutoring sessions first before making a decision.

options.text: Organic chemistry is difficult for everyone, don't worry.
Before dropping it, why don't you try the free tutoring sessions?
You should have chosen an easier subject.
I dropped that course when I was a student too.
That course is not required for your degree anyway.

explanation_tr: Ogrenci 'I'll try the tutoring sessions first' dedigine gore, danismanin tutoring sessions'dan (ozel ders/destek dersleri) bahsetmis olmasi gerekir.
rule_tr: Cevaptaki anahtar kelimeyi (tutoring sessions) sonraki replikte ara ve eslestirecek secenegi bul.
tip_tr: 'Tutoring sessions' ifadesi hem soruda hem cevapta eslesmeli.

stem:
Landlord: The rent is 500 euros per month, utilities included.
Erasmus Student: _____
Landlord: I understand. The best I can do is 450 euros.

options.text: That's a wonderful price! I'll take it immediately.
That's a bit above my budget. Is there any possibility of a discount?
I need to think about it for a few weeks.

explanation_tr: Ev sahibi 'The best I can do is 450' diyerek fiyat indirimi yapiyor. Bu, ogrencinin fiyati yuksek bulup pazarlik ettigini gosterir. C secenegi butceyi astigini ve indirim istedigini soyluyor.
rule_tr: Fiyat indirimi cevabi (I can do X euros) = karsi taraf pazarlik yapmistir.
tip_tr: 'The best I can do is...' = bir pazarlik cevabi. Demek ki ogrenci indirim istemis.

stem:
Customer: I have a terrible headache. Can you recommend something?
Pharmacist: _____
Customer: No, I'm not. I'll take the ibuprofen then. Thank you.

options.text: You should see a doctor immediately.
Ibuprofen works well for headaches. Are you allergic to any medications?
We don't sell pain medication without a prescription.
How long have you had this headache?
You should drink more water and rest.

explanation_tr: Musterinin 'No, I'm not' (Hayir, degilim) demesi bir evet/hayir sorusuna cevap verdigini gosterir. 'I'll take the ibuprofen' demesi de ibuprofenin onerildigini gosterir. B secenegi hem oneri hem alerji sorusu iceriyor.
rule_tr: 'No, I'm not' = Yes/No sorusu sorulmus. 'Allergic' sorusu bununla uyumlu.
tip_tr: Iki ipucu: 1) 'No, I'm not' → alerji sorusu 2) 'I'll take the ibuprofen' → ibuprofen onerilmis.

stem:
Maria: We need to divide the work for the group presentation. I'll handle the introduction.
Pierre: I can do the literature review.
Ayse: _____
Maria: Perfect! That leaves the conclusion for Kenji.

options.text: I don't want to do any work.
I'll prepare the data analysis section.
Why don't we ask the professor for help?
I think we should cancel the presentation.

explanation_tr: Maria 'That leaves the conclusion for Kenji' (sonuc Kenji'ye kaliyor) dedigine gore herkes bir bolum almis. Maria = introduction, Pierre = literature review, Ayse = bir bolum daha almali. B secenegi veri analizi bolumunu ustleniyor.
rule_tr: Is bolusu diyaloglarinda her kisi bir gorev ustlenir. Eksik kalan bolumu dolduran secenegi bul.
tip_tr: Introduction (Maria), Literature Review (Pierre), ??? (Ayse), Conclusion (Kenji) — Ayse'nin data analysis'i almasi mantikli.

stem:
Student: I submitted my assignment on time, but the system shows it as 'late submission'.
Professor: _____
Student: Yes, I have a screenshot showing the date and time of my submission.

options.text: Late submissions are not accepted in my course.
That might be a system error. Do you have any proof of your submission time?
You should be more careful next time.
I can't change the grade once it's recorded.
The submission deadline was clearly stated in the syllabus.

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin 'Yes, I have a screenshot' demesi bir kanit sorusuna cevap verdigini gosterir. B secenegi sistem hatasi olabilecegini ve kanit istedigini iceriyor.
rule_tr: 'Yes, I have...' = biri bir sey istemis/sormuis. 'Proof/evidence' sorusu ekran goruntüsu cevabıyla uyumlu.
tip_tr: Ogrenci screenshot (ekran goruntusu) paylasacaksa, profesor kanit istemis olmali.

stem:
Interviewer: Why did you choose to apply for this internship programme?
Candidate: _____
Interviewer: That's impressive. Your international experience would certainly be an asset.

options.text: I just need some work experience for my CV.
My parents told me to apply.
I'm passionate about healthcare research, and my Erasmus experience in Germany gave me valuable intercultural skills.
I don't really know. I saw the advertisement online.
I heard the salary is quite good.

explanation_tr: Gorusmecinin 'Your international experience would certainly be an asset' (uluslararasi deneyiminiz kesinlikle bir avantaj olur) demesi, adayin uluslararasi deneyimden bahsettigini gosterir. C secenegi Erasmus deneyimini ve kulturlerarasi becerileri vurguluyor.
rule_tr: Mulakat diyaloglarinda gorusmecinin yorumu, adayin ne soyledigine dair ipucu verir.
tip_tr: 'International experience' gorusmecinin yorumunda anahtar kelime — adayin da bunu soylemis olmasi gerekir.

stem:
Erasmus Student: I'd like to open a student bank account, please.
Bank Officer: Of course. I'll need your passport, student ID, and proof of address.
Erasmus Student: _____
Bank Officer: A utility bill or your dormitory contract would work.

options.text: I have my passport and student ID, but what counts as proof of address?
I don't have any of those documents.
How much money do I need to deposit?
Can I open the account online instead?
What are the interest rates for savings?

explanation_tr: Banka gorevlisi 'A utility bill or your dormitory contract would work' (fatura veya yurt sozlesmesi olur) dedigine gore, ogrenci adres kaniti olarak ne gerektigini sormis olmali.
rule_tr: Karsi tarafin verdigi cevap, sorulan soruyu yansitir. 'Proof of address' sorusu = adres kaniti aciklamasi.
tip_tr: 'What counts as...' sorusunun cevabi 'A utility bill or...' seklinde örneklerle gelir.

stem:
Nurse: What happened to your arm?
Student: I fell off my bicycle on the way to campus.
Nurse: _____
Student: Yes, I can move it, but it hurts a lot when I bend it.

options.text: You should have worn a helmet.
Cycling is dangerous in this city.
Can you move it? Does it hurt when you bend it?
We need to call an ambulance immediately.
When did you last have a tetanus shot?

explanation_tr: Ogrencinin 'Yes, I can move it, but it hurts a lot when I bend it' demesi iki soruya cevap verdigini gosterir: 1) Hareket edebiliyor musun? 2) Bukünce acıyor mu? C secenegi bu iki soruyu iceriyor.
rule_tr: Birden fazla bilgi iceren cevap, birden fazla soru soruldugunu gosterir.
tip_tr: 'Yes, I can move it' = hareket sorusu, 'it hurts when I bend it' = agri sorusu.

stem:
Marco: The international food festival is next Saturday. Are you going to cook something from your country?
Fatma: _____
Marco: Turkish food is delicious! I'm sure everyone will love it.

options.text: I don't know how to cook anything.
I'm thinking of making baklava and lentil soup.
Food festivals are a waste of time.
I'm not going to the festival.
What are you going to cook?

explanation_tr: Marco'nun 'Turkish food is delicious!' demesi Fatma'nin Turk yemegi yapacagini soylemis oldugunu gosterir. B secenegi baklava ve mercimek corbasi yapmayı düşündüğünü soyluyor.
rule_tr: 'Turkish food' anahtar kelimesi — Fatma Turk yemeklerinden bahsetmis olmali.
tip_tr: Marco'nun 'Turkish food' ve 'everyone will love it' demesi, Fatma'nin somut Turk yemekleri saydigini gosterir.

stem:
Erasmus Student: How do I get to the city centre from here?
Local Student: _____
Erasmus Student: Is there a student discount on the bus?

options.text: The city centre is not very interesting.
You can take the number 7 bus from the stop across the street.
The city centre is about 5 kilometres away.

explanation_tr: Erasmus ogrencisi 'Is there a student discount on the bus?' dedigine gore, yerel ogrenci otobus yol tarifi vermis olmali. B secenegi 7 numarali otobusu ve duragi soyluyor.
rule_tr: Sonraki replikte 'bus' geciyorsa, bir onceki replikte de bus'tan bahsedilmis olmali.
tip_tr: 'Student discount on the bus' ifadesi, onerilen ulasiimin otobus oldugunu kanitlar.

stem: Your friend tells you that her grandmother passed away last week. She is visibly upset. What would you say?

options.text: Don't worry, you'll get over it soon.
I'm so sorry for your loss. If you need anything, I'm here for you.
My grandmother died too, and I was fine after a while.
At least she lived a long life.
Let's go out tonight to take your mind off it.

explanation_tr: Birinin yakinini kaybettiginde bas sagligı ve destek sunmak en uygun davranistir. 'I'm so sorry for your loss' taziye ifadesidir. 'I'm here for you' destek sunar.
rule_tr: Taziye: I'm sorry for your loss / My condolences / I'm here for you / If there's anything I can do...
tip_tr: 'Passed away' = vefat etti. Taziye + destek ifadesi beklenir.

stem: During a group discussion, a classmate says that online exams are easier than classroom exams. You disagree. What would you say?

options.text: That's completely wrong and you have no idea what you're talking about.
I see your point, but I think online exams have their own challenges, like technical problems.
You obviously haven't taken an online exam before.

explanation_tr: Akademik bir tartismada kibar bir sekilde ayri dusmek icin once karsi tarafin fikrini onaylar (I see your point), sonra kendi gorusunu belirtirsin (but I think...).
rule_tr: Kibar itiraz: I see your point, but... / I understand what you mean, however... / That's a good point, but...
tip_tr: Once karsi tarafin fikrini onayla, sonra 'but' ile kendi gorusunu sun.

stem: You have just arrived at a new university as an Erasmus student. You need to find the International Students Office. What would you say to someone on campus?

options.text: Where is the International Students Office? Tell me now!
Excuse me, could you tell me where the International Students Office is?
I'm lost and I don't like this campus.
Take me to the International Students Office.
Does this university have an International Students Office?

explanation_tr: Taninmayan birine kibar bir sekilde yer sormak icin 'Excuse me, could you tell me where...?' yapisi kullanilir. Resmi ve saygili bir ifadedir.
rule_tr: Kibar yol sorma: Excuse me, could you tell me where... is? / Do you know where... is?
tip_tr: 'Excuse me' ile baslayan ve 'could you' iceren ifadeler en kibar soru bicimdir.

stem: Your professor asks why you didn't attend last week's seminar. You were ill and have a medical report. What would you say?

options.text: I didn't come because the seminar is boring.
I wasn't feeling well, and I forgot to inform you.
I was unwell last week, Professor. Here is my medical report as proof.
It's none of your business why I was absent.

explanation_tr: Resmi ortamda mazeret sunarken 1) Nedeni acikla 2) Belge sun. C secenegi hem hastalik aciklamasi hem tibbi rapor sunuyor.
rule_tr: Resmi mazeret: 1) Ozur ifadesi 2) Nedenini acikla 3) Varsa belge/kanit sun
tip_tr: Durumda 'medical report' bilgisi verilmis — bu belgeyi sunmak en profesyonel yaklasim.

stem: You notice that your classmate is about to drink from a cup that has someone else's medication dissolved in it by mistake. What would you say?

options.text: That's an interesting cup you have.
I wouldn't drink that if I were you.
Stop! Don't drink that! There's medication in it!
Would you like some coffee instead?

explanation_tr: Tehlikeli bir durumda hemen ve net bir uyari vermek gerekir. 'Stop! Don't drink that!' acil ve dogrudan bir uyaridir. Kibarlik degil, guvenlik onceliklidir.
rule_tr: Acil tehlike uyarisi: Stop! / Watch out! / Don't + fiil! + neden aciklamasi
tip_tr: Hayati tehlike varsa kibar olmaya calisma, dogrudan ve guclu uyar.

stem: Your roommate is very nervous about her first presentation in English. She says she will probably fail. What would you say?

options.text: You're probably right. English presentations are very hard.
Don't worry. You've prepared well, and I'm sure you'll do great!
Just read from your notes and it will be fine.
Maybe you should skip the presentation.

explanation_tr: Cesaretlendirmek icin endiselerini azaltmak (Don't worry) ve olumlu bir beklenti sunmak (you'll do great) gerekir.
rule_tr: Cesaret verme: Don't worry / You'll be fine / I believe in you / You've got this!
tip_tr: 'Nervous' = gergın. Gergin birine cesaret vermen beklenir, olumsuzlugu artirma.

stem: You need to ask your professor for a one-week extension on your thesis deadline because of a family emergency. What would you say in an email?

options.text: I want more time for my thesis. Give me one extra week.
Dear Professor, due to a family emergency, I would like to request a one-week extension for my thesis deadline. I would be grateful for your understanding.
Hi Prof, I need more time, is that cool?
I can't finish my thesis on time. It's your problem now.
Professor, the thesis deadline is too short for everyone.

explanation_tr: Resmi e-postada 1) Hitap (Dear Professor) 2) Neden (family emergency) 3) Net talep (one-week extension) 4) Kapanış (grateful for your understanding) olmali.
rule_tr: Resmi e-posta: Dear + hitap, neden + talep + tesekkur/kapanış
tip_tr: 'I would like to request' en kibar ve resmi talep bicimidir.

stem: A tourist asks you how to get to the nearest hospital. You know the way. What would you say?

options.text: Go straight ahead for two blocks, then turn right. The hospital is on the left side.
You can search for it on your phone.
Hospitals are usually near the city centre.

explanation_tr: Yol tarifi isterken net ve adim adim talimatlar vermek gerekir. B secenegi yol tarifi veriyor: duz git, saga don, sol tarafta.
rule_tr: Yol tarifi: Go straight / Turn right/left / It's on the right/left side / Walk for X minutes
tip_tr: Durumda 'You know the way' deniyor — yol tarifi ver, baska seyler soyleme.

stem: Your classmate, who always gets low grades, has just scored the highest mark on the final exam. What would you say?

options.text: Did you cheat on the exam?
That's impossible. There must be a mistake.
Wow, that's amazing! Congratulations! Your hard work really paid off.
The exam must have been really easy this time.
I don't believe you at all.

explanation_tr: Birinin beklenmedik basarisina karsi saskinlik + tebrik + takdir gostermek uygun tepkidir. Suphe veya alaycilık yapmak kaba olur.
rule_tr: Beklenmedik basari: Surprise (Wow!) + Congratulations + Pozitif yorum (Your hard work paid off)
tip_tr: Asla suphecilik gosterme. Olumlu ve destekleyici ol.

stem: Your friends want to order pizza for dinner, but you are a vegetarian and the options they are choosing all contain meat. What would you say?

options.text: I don't like pizza at all.
Pizza is unhealthy. We should eat something else.
Could we also order a vegetarian option? I don't eat meat.
Fine, I'll eat whatever you order.

explanation_tr: Tercihini kibar bir sekilde belirtip alternatif onermek en uygun yaklasim. 'Could we also...' kibar bir oneri + nedenini acikliyor (I don't eat meat).
rule_tr: Tercih belirtme: Could we... / Would it be possible to... / I'd prefer... because...
tip_tr: 'Could we also' = mevcut plani bozmadan kendi ihtiyacini kibarça belirtmek.

stem: (I) Vaccination is one of the most effective ways to prevent infectious diseases. (II) Vaccines work by training the immune system to recognise and fight specific pathogens. (III) The discovery of penicillin by Alexander Fleming revolutionised the treatment of bacterial infections. (IV) Thanks to widespread vaccination programmes, diseases like smallpox have been completely eradicated. (V) However, misinformation about vaccines on social media has led to a decline in vaccination rates in some communities.
explanation_tr: Paragraf asi (vaccination) hakkinda: faydalari, calisma mekanizmasi, basarisi ve yanlis bilgi sorunu. III. cumle penisilin ve bakteri enfeksiyonlarinin tedavisinden bahsediyor — asi konusuyla dogrudan ilgisiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: asilama. Penisilin/antibiyotik farkli bir tip konusudur.
tip_tr: Penisilin ve asi ikisi de tip alani ama farkli konular. Paragrafin spesifik konusu 'asilama'.

stem: (I) Artificial intelligence is transforming the healthcare industry in remarkable ways. (II) AI-powered diagnostic tools can analyse medical images faster and more accurately than human doctors in some cases. (III) The first computer was invented in the 1940s and occupied an entire room. (IV) Machine learning algorithms are being used to predict patient outcomes and personalise treatment plans. (V) Despite these advances, ethical concerns about data privacy and algorithmic bias remain significant challenges.
explanation_tr: Paragraf yapay zekanin saglik sektorundeki rolleri hakkinda. III. cumle ilk bilgisayarin icadından bahsediyor — AI ve saglik konusuyla alakasiz bir bilgi.
rule_tr: Ana konu: AI + saglik. Bilgisayarin tarihi farkli bir konudur.
tip_tr: III. cumle ilginc bir bilgi olabilir ama paragrafin ozel konusu 'AI in healthcare'dir.

stem: (I) Studying abroad through the Erasmus programme requires careful financial planning. (II) Students must budget for accommodation, food, transportation, and personal expenses. (III) The European Union was founded in 1993 with the signing of the Maastricht Treaty. (IV) Many universities offer additional grants to help Erasmus students cover their living costs. (V) Students who plan their finances in advance tend to have a more enjoyable and stress-free experience abroad.
explanation_tr: Paragraf Erasmus programinda finansal planlama hakkinda. III. cumle AB'nin kurulusundan bahsediyor — finansal planlama konusuyla alakasiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: Erasmus + finansal planlama. AB'nin kurulus tarihi farkli bir bilgi.
tip_tr: AB ve Erasmus iliskili olabilir ama paragrafin spesifik konusu 'finansal planlama'.

stem: (I) Academic writing requires a clear structure, logical argumentation, and proper referencing. (II) Students should support their claims with evidence from credible sources such as peer-reviewed journals. (III) The library at our university was built in 1965 and was recently renovated. (IV) Plagiarism — presenting someone else's work as your own — is a serious academic offence that can lead to expulsion. (V) Therefore, learning proper citation techniques is an essential skill for every university student.
explanation_tr: Paragraf akademik yazim kurallari hakkinda: yapi, kaynakca, intihal. III. cumle kutuphanenin yapi tarihinden bahsediyor — akademik yazim konusuyla alakasiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: akademik yazim kurallari. Kutuphanenin fiziksel tarihi bu konunun disinda.
tip_tr: Kutuphane akademik yasam ile iliskili olabilir ama paragrafin konusu 'akademik yazim'.

stem: (I) Mental health awareness has become increasingly important on university campuses. (II) Many universities now offer free counselling services to students who are struggling with anxiety or depression. (III) The tuition fees at private universities have risen by 15% in the last five years. (IV) Regular exercise, adequate sleep, and maintaining social connections are proven strategies for improving mental well-being. (V) Destigmatising mental health issues encourages more students to seek help when they need it.
explanation_tr: Paragraf universite kampuslerinde ruh sagligi farkindaligi hakkinda. III. cumle ozel universitelerin ucret artisi hakkinda — ruh sagligi konusuyla alakasiz.
rule_tr: Ana konu: ruh sagligi + universite. Ogretim ucretleri farkli bir konu.
tip_tr: Universite ile iliskili olsa da paragrafin ozel konusu 'mental health'dir. Ucret artisi bu konuyu desteklemiyor.
